spectral.strength_convention: s(n) = out-strength + in-strength of |g*W_beta| (our reading of the review's undirected convention, DISCLOSED as a choice on a directed graph)
spectral.note: lam1 by power iteration on the nonnegative operator (Perron-Frobenius); normalisation leg N1 divides depth-d sums by lam1^d so depths are comparable.

G1_crossing.interpretation: past d_conv every actor's walk direction is the leading eigenvector, so the per-mass value converges to (left-eigenvector overlap of the source) x a depth-independent constant: the DEPTH-RESOLVED question dies there and the deficit becomes a single depth-invariant number.

definitions.length: L_uv = -log10(A_uv / A_max), A = |g*W_beta| (our domain choice, DISCLOSED: the field normalises weights to (0,1] before the log)
definitions.SI: -log2(prod T) accumulated along the L-shortest path during relaxation (so it is the SI of the path the length metric picks)
definitions.tie_note: ties in L are broken by heap order; disclosed, not controlled.

G3_diffusion_vs_routing.reading: agreement = the carrier is both low-communicability AND hidden-route; disagreement DATES the avoidance to a broadcast-vs-route level and is informative, not an instrument failure (registered in advance, tick-233 amendment (d)).
G3_diffusion_vs_routing.field_prior: Seguin et al: diffusion beat routing for SC-FC correspondence (communicability +7.9% peak AMI over SC, p<1e-16; navigation the only model that made it WORSE).

N2_crofts.note: Crofts/Estrada strength normalisation applied to the weights BEFORE the walk sum; no spectral-death diagnostic, hence not primary (tick-233 amendment (b)). No null re-run on this leg: the swaps preserve out-strength but NOT every node's total strength under the sqrt(s_i s_j) transform, so a Crofts null would not be the registered null — DISCLOSED, and the leg is reported as an ordering check only.
